notes: 83 normal-combat Sora candidate names, 2 Bumble-Rumble-only names, 13 Riku names. These are extracted source counts, not certified native menu or achievement denominators. Attack illustrations normalize to Attack; explicit same/different type constraints remain in reference text. Individual-card recipe illustrations followed by a generic clause are examples, not extra constraints. All 92 stock recipes now have ordered alternatives and explicit constraints; six duels have activation conditions. The documented three-card-over-two-card priority is integrated; arbitrary slot/overlap matching remains unverified.
